title: Smooth Sailing
summary:
Taking stock of the TMX expansion
The Trans Mountain Expansion (TMX) pipeline exported its first crude oil cargo from the Westridge terminal in Burnaby, British Columbia, in May of this year. Now, some 5 months later, it is time to take a preliminary look at the impact that this important new export outlet on the west coast of the Americas is having on the oil and tanker markets in the Pacific.
